title: Normalized coefficient changes between counit presentations
statement: For two ringed coefficient counit presentations over the same small sites, geometric morphism, coefficient ring and constant-coefficient inverse-image lift [def-pur-ringed-coefficient-counit-presentations], let $b_X:R_X\to R'_X$, $b_Y:R_Y\to R'_Y$ and $b_I:R_I\to R'_I$ be ring-sheaf homomorphisms. Define LocalizedRestrictionChangeData for one site component, and CoefficientRestrictionChangeData for the two components (the eight restriction-comparison data fields below), CoefficientRestrictionChangeNormalized for their nine explicit compatibility and normalization equations, and CoefficientRestrictionChange for the data together with these proofs; define CoefficientDirectChangeData and ConstantDerivedChangeData for the other comparison data, their respective Normalized propositions for the displayed equations, and CoefficientDirectChange and ConstantDerivedChange for these data together with the proofs, and CoefficientChangeData to assemble them, CoefficientChangeNormalized for the mate equation, and CoefficientChange for the assembled data and its proof, recording their compatibility with the constant-coefficient algebra maps, inverse-image lift and structural maps; derived restrictions $V_X,V_Y$ identified with termwise restriction by localization factorization isomorphisms; the canonical restriction-composition isomorphisms $\rho_X:U_XV_X\cong U'_X$ and $\rho_Y:U_YV_Y\cong U'_Y$ fixed on complexes by their ordinary underlying-identity maps; the ordinary direct-image comparison fixed by its geometric underlying-identity equation; its derived comparison $\beta:V_YF'_R\cong F_RV_X$ fixed on K-injective representatives by the composition formula $f_*j$; the constant-coefficient derived identifications $\alpha:Q_A\cong Q'_A$ and $\gamma:F'_A\cong F_A$ fixed by their localization and K-injective equations; and $\sigma:Q_RV_Y\to V_XQ'_R$ fixed as the adjoint mate of $\beta$ after the primed derived unit. Define CoefficientChange.IsNatural to be the conjunction of the following actual equalities for all derived objects $M\in D(R'_Y)$ and $K\in D(R'_X)$: $\tau'_M\,\alpha_{U'_YM}\,Q_A(\rho_{Y,M})=\rho_{X,Q'_RM}\,U_X(\sigma_M)\,\tau_{V_YM}$ and $F_A(\rho_{X,K})\,\kappa_{V_XK}\,U_Y(\beta_K)=\gamma_{U'_XK}\,\kappa'_K\,\rho_{Y,F'_RK}$. No such naturality equality is an input field of CoefficientChange.
